reports.headline: Strange Activity Reported at Abandoned Theater
reports.body: Residents near the old theater {dir} of the village {dist} report hearing dialogue and music after midnight despite the building having no power. Several claim the same film appears to play every night. {name} entered three nights ago and has not returned.

reports.headline: The Theater Is Showing a Film Again
reports.body: The theater {dir} of here {dist} closed years ago, yet music drifts out of it every night after dark. {name} looked through a crack in the boards and says the seats were full, and that every face in the audience was turned around, looking back at {them}.
